MATL_DB.description: Material DB Lookup (MATL_DB). Retrieves the built-in material database name list for a given material type or design standard; the type/standard is supplied via the URL path parameter ({TYPE or STANDARD}), so the request body carries no fields.

Argument.description: Empty request body (DTO_EMPTY). All input is provided through the URL path parameter (e.g. CONC/STEEL/ALUMINUM for the full standard list, or a specific standard like 'ASTM(S)').
